Data Engineer – Data Pipelines & Orchestration
We are looking for a Data Engineer who can manage data pipelines, integrations, data workflows, and orchestration using tools such as Kestra. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring that data moves reliably between different systems, is properly transformed and validated, and is available for analytics, reporting, AI applications, and business operations.
This role requires someone who is comfortable working with databases, APIs, ETL/ELT processes, workflow orchestration, and cloud-based data infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities:
- Design, build, maintain, and monitor data pipelines using Kestra and other ETL/ELT tools.
- Create and manage scheduled, event-driven, and automated workflows.
- Integrate data from APIs, databases, SaaS platforms, files, and other external sources.
- Perform data extraction, transformation, validation, and loading.
- Manage data across different databases and systems.
- Monitor pipeline execution, identify failures, troubleshoot issues, and ensure timely resolution.
- Implement error handling, retries, logging, alerts, and pipeline monitoring.
- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and reliability.
- Develop SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, validation, and analysis.
- Work with relational and non-relational databases.
- Build reusable and scalable data workflows.
- Manage data ingestion from third-party APIs and external systems.
- Document pipelines, workflows, integrations, dependencies, and data sources.
- Optimize existing pipelines for performance, reliability, and cost.
- Collaborate with software developers, BI/analytics teams, product teams, and business stakeholders.
- Support data requirements for dashboards, reporting, automation, and AI/ML applications.
- Maintain appropriate data security, access controls, and governance practices.
Requirements:
- Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
- Hands-on experience with Kestra or similar workflow orchestration platforms.
- Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data pipelines.
- Experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
- Experience with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or similar.
- Good understanding of JSON, CSV, XML, and other common data formats.
- Experience with Python for data processing and automation.
- Understanding of data validation, transformation, and quality checks.
- Familiarity with Git and basic software development practices.
- Understanding of scheduling, dependencies, retries, logging, and monitoring of data workflows.
- Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Good to Have:
- Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms.
- Experience with Docker and containerized workloads.
- Experience with data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or similar.
- Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Looker, or Metabase.
- Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming technologies.
- Familiarity with Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, n8n, or similar orchestration platforms.
- Experience working with AI/ML data pipelines.
- Understanding of data governance and data security.
- Experience building monitoring and alerting systems for production pipelines.
What we are looking for:
The ideal candidate is someone who doesn't just build pipelines but takes ownership of the entire data flow.
You should be comfortable asking:
- Where does the data come from?
- Is the data complete and accurate?
- How should it be transformed?
- Where should it be stored?
- What happens if the pipeline fails?
- How do we know the pipeline is working?
- How can the workflow be made more reliable and scalable?
- Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to troubleshoot production data issues are essential.
Experience:
3–5 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Operations, ETL/ELT, or a similar role.
Candidates with strong hands-on experience in Kestra and data pipeline management may be considered even if their overall experience is outside the traditional Data Engineering path.

Senior Database Engineer
Job purpose
The PostgreSQL Database Lead / Senior Database Developer owns the design, build and performance of the database
layer for a large-scale, multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS platform. The role suits an engineer who has built transactional
systems where data accuracy, auditability and tenant isolation are non-negotiable.
The role holder makes foundational data architecture decisions on a greenfield platform and takes them through to
production. They work closely with solution architects, backend engineers, data and AI engineers, DevOps and
security teams. They also set database standards and guide other developers.
Here are the key technical skills and knowledge areas that an PostgreSQL back-end architect should possess:
Technical Skills
• 6+ years of database development experience, with at least 5 years focused on PostgreSQL and 2+ years in a lead or senior role.
• Proven experience as a database lead or senior developer on large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS applications in the cloud.
• In-depth knowledge of PostgreSQL architecture and internals.
• Expert SQL and PL/pgSQL programming, including complex queries, functions and stored procedures.
• Strong data modelling skills across normalised transactional schemas, with experience in financial, ledger or other high-integrity transactional data.
• Expertise in performance tuning, including query optimisation, indexing and partitioning.
• Hands-on experience implementing multi-tenant isolation, including row-level security.
• Experience designing and operating highly available PostgreSQL: replication, failover, backup and recovery, point-in-time recovery and disaster recovery.
• Experience with managed PostgreSQL services on a major cloud platform, preferably Azure.
• Working knowledge of connection pooling and connection management.
• Experience managing version-controlled schema migrations through CI/CD pipelines.
• Scripting in Python and/or shell for automation and monitoring.
• Solid understanding of database security, including access control, encryption, auditing and protection of personal and financial data.
• Takes end-to-end ownership of the data layer and balances sound architecture with delivery speed.
• Leads by example: sets standards, runs design reviews and mentors developers.
• Diagnoses complex performance and data-integrity issues methodically.
• Communicates trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Job Description
Good to have:
• Experience with Azure cloud services.
• Experience supporting analytics, reporting or AI data workloads.
• Experience scaling PostgreSQL for high data volumes.
• Familiarity with infrastructure as code and DevOps practices.
• Exposure to Node.js-based applications.
• Experience in accounting, fintech or other financial software.
• Exposure to security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
Duties and responsibilities
• Translate business requirements and non-functional requirements (NFRs) into database designs with measurable acceptance criteria.
• Design PostgreSQL solutions that meet agreed targets for performance, scalability, availability, security and recoverability.
• Define data models, schemas, constraints and configurations that protect data integrity.
• Design data models for financial and transactional records, including immutable audit trails, precise monetary handling and reconciliation controls.
• Define the multi-tenant data isolation strategy, such as row-level security and tenant-aware partitioning and prevent cross-tenant data access.
• Design for data residency, retention and multi-region deployment where regulatory or contractual requirements apply.
• Build and maintain database objects: tables, indexes, views, functions, stored procedures and triggers.
• Analyse execution plans and optimise queries, indexing, partitioning and database configuration.
• Ensure correctness under concurrency through appropriate isolation levels, locking strategies and idempotent processing.
• Design reliable data integration patterns with application and event-driven services, such as the transactional outbox and idempotent ingestion of external data.
• Plan and run data migration, transformation and loading, including validation and reconciliation.
• Design storage and retrieval for AI features, including vector embeddings, while keeping tenant isolation intact.
• Enable change data capture and replication to analytics and machine learning platforms without degrading transactional performance.
• Support data quality, lineage and protection of sensitive data used in analytics and AI workloads.
• Work with cloud operations and DevOps teams to design, implement and test high availability and disaster recovery against agreed RTO and RPO targets.
• Define and regularly test backup, restore and point-in-time recovery procedures.
• Monitor performance, investigate bottlenecks and concurrency issues, and lead root-cause analysis and remediation.
• Run capacity planning and validate scalability under expected and peak workloads.
• Implement least-privilege access, encryption at rest and in transit, and database auditing.
• Work with security and compliance teams to provide controls and evidence for privacy regulations and audit frameworks.
• Manage schema changes as version-controlled code, delivered through CI/CD with migration testing, rollback plans and zero-downtime deployment patterns.
Job Description
• Establish database development standards, review designs and code, and mentor developers.
• Maintain clear technical documentation for data models, procedures and operational runbooks.
• To adhere to the Information Security Management policies and procedures.
Qualifications/Experience
Degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline or the equivalent combination of education, technical
certifications and work experience.

In this role, you will bridge cloud pipelines and edge runtimes: precomputing, embedding, and indexing clinical reports and audio assets in the cloud, and delivering optimized local inference (GGUF, ONNX, Whisper.cpp) directly to disconnected field devices. You will build safe and secure low-latency retrieval systems where network access is intermittent or absent, hallucinations are unacceptable, and citation transparency is mandatory.
In this role you will collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams across various domains.

Edge Inference Deployment: Deploy, benchmark, and optimize local inference runtimes (llama.cpp, ONNX runtime, whisper.cpp) on low-power edge platforms (Linux, Android, low-spec x86/ARM).

Hybrid RAG & Grounding: Build and evaluate hybrid retrieval pipelines (BM25 + dense vector + cross-encoder reranking) paired with strict citation mapping and deterministic safety guardrails.
Low-Bandwidth Synchronization: Design robust sync mechanisms (delta updates, compressed snapshot packaging) to push updated models and indexes from cloud pipelines to edge devices over unstable networks.
API & System Integration: Develop lightweight local APIs (FastAPI / REST / MCP) and user-facing streaming components with robust logging, debugging, and model hot-swapping.
Engineering Standards: Write maintainable, well-tested code, participate in design and code reviews, and maintain automated regression evaluation suites.
Required Skills & Experience
Local & Edge Inference: Hands-on experience running models locally via llama.cpp, ONNX runtime, or Whisper.cpp on CPU-only or memory-constrained hardware.
Advanced RAG & Vector Search: Proven experience building hybrid search pipelines (sparse + dense), cross-encoder reranking, and managing vector databases/snapshots (ChromaDB, FAISS, or SQLite-vec).
Quantization & Model Artifacts: Practical knowledge of GGUF quantization levels (K-quants), ONNX graph optimization, and bi-encoder/cross-encoder export workflows.
Clinical Guardrails & Grounding: Experience implementing structured outputs, strict citation tracking, and safety guardrails (e.g., NeMo Guardrails) to eliminate hallucinations.
Backend & Systems Python: Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, asyncio, pytest) and multi-stage containerization using Docker.
Offline/Sync Fundamentals: Understanding of differential sync, immutable snapshot delivery, or delta compression over unreliable connections.
Engineering Practices: Solid grounding in Git version control, CI/CD automation, and test-driven development.

3+ years of software/AI engineering experience shipping models into real-world production environments.
Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical discipline.
Familiarity with C/C++ build toolchains (CMake, Make) or compiling native libraries for target architectures (x86_64, ARM64).

About the Role
You will work with a security-focused developer on the engineering team. That developer fixes code-level findings and builds the automation that turns cloud alerts into Jira tickets. You set the direction: you decide what to test, how severe a finding is, and when a fix is good enough to close.
What You’ll Do
Penetration Testing & Segmentation (primary focus)
· Plan and run internal network penetration tests across our PCI and non-PCI cloud environments. Agree the scope and rules of engagement with system owners first.
· Run segmentation tests at least every six months, and after any significant change, to prove that the Cardholder Data Environment (CDE) is isolated from the rest of the network.
· Perform manual web application and API penetration tests on our customer-facing applications, including login, redemption and checkout flows.
· Go beyond scanner output: confirm what can actually be exploited, and chain small weaknesses into a realistic attack path.
· Write clear reports with evidence, a risk rating and practical fix guidance. Retest after remediation.
ASV Scanning & PCI DSS
· Manage our monthly ASV scans through our Approved Scanning Vendor. Keep the list of in-scope external assets current, review each report, dispute false positives with evidence, drive fixes, rescan, and secure a passing scan every quarter.
· Lead PCI scope definition with engineering after our recent cloud migration and for the new disaster recovery environment. Keep the CDE inventory, data-flow diagrams and network diagrams current.
· Validate network segmentation and external controls that keep the CDE isolated.
· Prepare evidence for and support our annual PCI DSS assessment with our QSA, and our SOC 2 audit.
Vulnerability Management
· Own the vulnerability management programme for cloud infrastructure in Orca Security: triage findings, set severity in the context of our platform, raise Jira tickets, assign owners, track SLAs, retest and close.
· Oversee code-level findings (SAST and SCA) that the engineering-side security developer triages and fixes. Make the final severity call and sign off on closure.
· Run regular remediation review meetings with DevOps, infrastructure and engineering. Keep SOPs and tracking current in Confluence.
Logging & Alerting
· Define the threat scenarios we must alert on from GCP Cloud Logging, Audit Logs and Security Command Center.
· Review the alert rules that engineering builds, and tune them to cut false positives.
· Investigate the alert tickets that arrive in Jira and escalate real incidents.

Job purpose
The PostgreSQL Database Lead / Senior Database Developer owns the design, build and performance of the database layer for a large-scale, multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS platform. The role suits an engineer who has built transactional systems where data accuracy, auditability and tenant isolation are non-negotiable. The role holder makes foundational data architecture decisions on a greenfield platform and takes them through to production. They work closely with solution architects, backend engineers, data and AI engineers, DevOps and security teams. They also set database standards and guide other developers.
Here are the key technical skills and knowledge areas that an PostgreSQL back-end architect should possess: Technical Skills • 6+ years of database development experience, with at least 5 years focused on PostgreSQL and 2+ years in a lead or senior role. • Proven experience as a database lead or senior developer on large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS applications in the cloud. • In-depth knowledge of PostgreSQL architecture and internals. • Expert SQL and PL/pgSQL programming, including complex queries, functions and stored procedures. • Strong data modelling skills across normalised transactional schemas, with experience in financial, ledger or other high-integrity transactional data. • Expertise in performance tuning, including query optimisation, indexing and partitioning. • Hands-on experience implementing multi-tenant isolation, including row-level security. • Experience designing and operating highly available PostgreSQL: replication, failover, backup and recovery, point-in-time recovery and disaster recovery. • Experience with managed PostgreSQL services on a major cloud platform, preferably Azure. • Working knowledge of connection pooling and connection management. • Experience managing version-controlled schema migrations through CI/CD pipelines. • Scripting in Python and/or shell for automation and monitoring. • Solid understanding of database security, including access control, encryption, auditing and protection of personal and financial data. • Takes end-to-end ownership of the data layer and balances sound architecture with delivery speed. • Leads by example: sets standards, runs design reviews and mentors developers. • Diagnoses complex performance and data-integrity issues methodically. • Communicates trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Job Description Good to have: • Experience with Azure cloud services. • Experience supporting analytics, reporting or AI data workloads. • Experience scaling PostgreSQL for high data volumes. • Familiarity with infrastructure as code and DevOps practices. • Exposure to Node.js-based applications. • Experience in accounting, fintech or other financial software. • Exposure to security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
Duties and responsibilities • Translate business requirements and non-functional requirements (NFRs) into database designs with measurable acceptance criteria. • Design PostgreSQL solutions that meet agreed targets for performance, scalability, availability, security and recoverability. • Define data models, schemas, constraints and configurations that protect data integrity. • Design data models for financial and transactional records, including immutable audit trails, precise monetary handling and reconciliation controls. • Define the multi-tenant data isolation strategy, such as row-level security and tenant-aware partitioning and prevent cross-tenant data access. • Design for data residency, retention and multi-region deployment where regulatory or contractual requirements apply. • Build and maintain database objects: tables, indexes, views, functions, stored procedures and triggers. • Analyse execution plans and optimise queries, indexing, partitioning and database configuration. • Ensure correctness under concurrency through appropriate isolation levels, locking strategies and idempotent processing. • Design reliable data integration patterns with application and event-driven services, such as the transactional outbox and idempotent ingestion of external data. • Plan and run data migration, transformation and loading, including validation and reconciliation. • Design storage and retrieval for AI features, including vector embeddings, while keeping tenant isolation intact. • Enable change data capture and replication to analytics and machine learning platforms without degrading transactional performance. • Support data quality, lineage and protection of sensitive data used in analytics and AI workloads. • Work with cloud operations and DevOps teams to design, implement and test high availability and disaster recovery against agreed RTO and RPO targets. • Define and regularly test backup, restore and point-in-time recovery procedures. • Monitor performance, investigate bottlenecks and concurrency issues, and lead root-cause analysis and remediation. • Run capacity planning and validate scalability under expected and peak workloads. • Implement least-privilege access, encryption at rest and in transit, and database auditing. • Work with security and compliance teams to provide controls and evidence for privacy regulations and audit frameworks. • Manage schema changes as version-controlled code, delivered through CI/CD with migration testing, rollback plans and zero-downtime deployment patterns. Job Description • Establish database development standards, review designs and code, and mentor developers. • Maintain clear technical documentation for data models, procedures and operational runbooks. • To adhere to the Information Security Management policies and procedures. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience analyzing application and server-side performance issues using Linux, heap dumps, thread dumps, Garbage Collection (GC) analysis, database analysis, flame graphs, and application/server-side monitoring tools. The candidate will work closely with application development, DevOps, infrastructure, and database teams to identify performance bottlenecks, conduct root-cause analysis, and drive performance improvements across enterprise applications.
Job Description
8+ years of overall IT experience, with significant experience in Performance Engineering / Application Performance Management.
Proven experience troubleshooting complex performance issues in enterprise applications.
Strong understanding of JVM internals, memory management, threading, GC, CPU and I/O behavior.
Strong Linux troubleshooting skills.
Ability to independently perform performance analysis and identify root causes rather than only execute predefined performance test scripts.
Experience working with development, DevOps, infrastructure, and database teams.
Responsibilities include:
Lead end-to-end application performance engineering and troubleshooting activities.
Analyze application and server performance issues across development, test, and production environments.
Perform detailed Linux system-level performance analysis, including CPU, memory, disk I/O, network, processes, and system resource utilization.
Analyze JVM heap dumps to identify memory leaks, excessive object creation, and memory-related bottlenecks.
Analyze thread dumps to identify deadlocks, thread contention, blocked/waiting threads, thread pool issues, and CPU-consuming threads.

Generate and analyze flame graphs for identifying CPU hotspots and application-level performance bottlenecks.
Use application and server-side monitoring/observability tools to identify performance degradation and correlate application, infrastructure, and database metrics.
Conduct root-cause analysis of performance incidents and provide actionable recommendations.
Work with development teams to identify inefficient code paths, resource utilization issues, memory problems, and concurrency-related bottlenecks.
Define performance baselines and monitor application performance against agreed SLAs/SLOs.
Lead performance optimization initiatives and validate improvements through benchmarking and load testing.
Prepare technical performance reports, bottleneck analysis, and optimization recommendations.
Mentor junior performance engineers and provide technical leadership across performance engineering initiatives.

job_description:
Digital Marketing Lead
Location: In-office, Technopark, Trivandrum, Kerala
Working hours: UK business hours (approx. 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM IST)
Employment type: Full-time
Compensation: Competitive, based on experience
About the Role
ImmiWorks India is the in-house delivery centre for an established UK group with over a decade of trading history and a strong reputation for client service. We are a young operation but not a start-up gamble. You get the stability, standards, and backing of a mature firm together with the energy and ownership of building a capability from the ground up.
We are building the marketing function that will drive growth across the group’s UK immigration service lines: corporate work (sponsor licence applications, compliance, audits and renewals) and individual work (visa renewals, ILR, naturalisation, and new subscription products).
The way our clients research is changing. More of the early, top-of-funnel questions that used to start on Google are now answered by AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT and similar tools, and we want to be the firm those answers draw on and cite.
This is a lead role, not a specialist one. Your first priority is building our visibility across traditional and AI search, hands-on: technical fixes, on-page work, content strategy and authority. Around that, you own how the digital channel performs as a whole: landing page conversion, analytics and attribution, direction of the paid media, and the wider digital mix. We need someone who has done this before, can show the before-and-after numbers, and is still hands-on enough to do the work rather than describe it.
You will be based at our Technopark office in Trivandrum, working in real-time alignment with UK business hours.
What You’ll Be Doing
Organic and AI search
• Auditing where we stand across technical health, content, authority and AI visibility, and turning that into a prioritised 12-month search roadmap with targets the business can track.
• Owning technical SEO: crawlability and indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals and page speed, structured data (schema), canonicals, redirects and sitemaps. Writing clear fix specifications and working with developers until fixes are shipped, not just listed.
• Owning on-page SEO: keyword and search-intent mapping to service pages, titles, headings and internal linking, and the E-E-A-T signals that matter in a regulated legal topic (author credentials, solicitor review, sources and freshness).
• Setting the content strategy around topic ownership: deciding which immigration topics we must own, building topic clusters and pillar pages, closing gaps against competitors, and refreshing or consolidating content that underperforms. Briefing writers and our lawyers, and editing for search without compromising legal accuracy.
• Owning off-page and authority building: auditing and cleaning up the existing backlink profile, and earning quality links and mentions through digital PR, legal and HR publications, credible directories and partner sites. Quality over volume, and no link schemes.
• Owning our visibility in AI search (GEO/AEO): how we appear in Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Copilot. Structuring content so it is clear, quotable and citable, strengthening entity and brand signals (Google Business Profile, consistent citations, reviews, third-party mentions), and tracking AI visibility and AI referral traffic over time.
Conversion and measurement
• Owning conversion at page level: page structure, messaging hierarchy, calls to action, trust signals and form friction on service and landing pages. Using A/B tests, heatmaps and session recordings to find and fix where enquiries are being lost.
• Owning measurement: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Search Console, UTMs, conversion tracking and CRM attribution, so every enquiry can be traced to its source, including organic and AI referrals.
• Reporting to UK leadership on visibility, traffic, enquiries, pipeline and cost per acquisition by channel and by service line, with a clear view on where the next pound of effort and budget should go.
Wider digital marketing
• Taking a service line brief from the UK team and turning it into a costed, multi-channel plan with clear targets (lead volume, cost per lead, conversion rate, ROAS).
• Directing paid media currently run by an external agency across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn and Meta: setting objectives, reviewing structure, spend and results, and making sure paid and organic work together on keywords, landing pages and remarketing. Over time, advising and planning to bring this in-house.
• Planning organic socials and directing the video and content pipeline, briefing what gets made based on what is performing and what supports search.
• Overseeing email and CRM marketing: segmentation, nurture sequences, renewal and cross-sell campaigns, and clean handover of qualified leads into sales.
• Supporting PR, thought leadership and partner marketing, with an eye on the authority, links and citations they generate.
preferred_skills:
Required Experience
• 5+ years in digital marketing, with SEO as a core part of your role for at least three of them (in-house or agency), and time owning results independently or leading the work.
• A proven organic growth track record. You have taken a site with weak traffic and authority and grown it, and can walk us through the before and after: traffic, rankings, enquiries, and what you did to get there.
• Hands-on technical SEO. You can run and interpret a crawl (Screaming Frog, Sitebulb or similar), diagnose issues in Search Console, implement schema, and write a fix specification a developer can act on.
• Content strategy built in practice: keyword research, intent mapping, topic clusters, briefs and content refreshes that measurably moved results.
• Ethical link building. You have audited and improved a backlink profile and earned quality links through digital PR, outreach or partnerships, and you know what not to do.
• Practical, current experience in AI search (GEO/AEO): you have worked on visibility in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity or similar, and can explain what you changed and how you measured it. The field is new, so we value evidenced experimentation over claimed expertise.
• Strong in GA4, GTM, Search Console and conversion tracking, and comfortable with page-level CRO and A/B testing. You make decisions on evidence, not instinct.
• Enough hands-on paid media experience (Google Ads at minimum) to audit an agency’s account, challenge their decisions and integrate paid with organic.
• Strong written English in a clear, professional UK register for a B2B audience. You will be shaping content that has to rank, be cited, and stay legally accurate.
• Able to brief, manage and hold agencies, freelancers and developers to their output.
• Service industry background. Professional services or a regulated sector (legal, immigration, consultancy, finance) is a strong advantage.
Desirable
• SEO experience in a YMYL sector (legal, finance, health) where E-E-A-T and accuracy carry extra weight.
• Experience marketing to UK or US audiences, including local search.
• Familiarity with compliance-driven B2B buyers: HR directors, in-house counsel, business owners.
• Experience running B2B and B2C campaigns within the same business. We do both.
• Tooling: SEMrush or Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Microsoft Clarity or Hotjar, AI visibility tracking tools, and Zoho CRM.
• Working knowledge of email automation and CRM-driven marketing.
• Experience building a marketing function rather than joining a finished one.
• Comfort working with AI-generated video and avatar content.
How We Work
You will be office-based at Technopark, Trivandrum, on full UK business hours, giving you real-time overlap with the UK team for briefings, approvals and decisions. The UK team sets brand, positioning and service strategy, and signs off anything client-facing for legal accuracy. Within that, search, conversion and digital execution are yours. We are building this function from the ground up, so you will have real ownership, a direct line to the people making the decisions, and the scope to grow as the function does.
How to Apply
Send your application to hr@immiworks.com
• Your CV and LinkedIn profile.
• A short note on why this role interests you.
• One organic growth case study: the starting position, what you changed (technical, content, authority, AI visibility), over what timeline, and what it returned in traffic, visibility and enquiries. Numbers matter more than narrative here.
We filter hard on signal. Show us results you owned and can evidence, not just activity.

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Android AOSP Hardware Enablement Engineer to bring up and enable automotive hardware platforms for Android Open Source Project (AOSP) and Android Automotive OS (AAOS) builds.
The engineer will be responsible for enabling the underlying hardware and software stack required to build, boot, and operate Android on an automotive SoC platform. This includes bootloader configuration, Linux kernel integration, device tree development, vendor BSP integration, hardware driver enablement, Android build configuration, and debugging of hardware-related boot and runtime issues.
The candidate will work closely with SoC vendors, hardware teams, BSP developers, kernel engineers, and Android framework teams to deliver a stable and functional Android infotainment platform.
Key Responsibilities
AOSP Build System and Platform Integration
Set up and maintain AOSP source code and development environments.
Configure and execute Android platform builds using Soong, Android.bp, Make, and related build tools.
Integrate vendor-provided Android BSP packages into the AOSP source tree.
Configure product definitions, device configurations, board configurations, and vendor-specific build components.
Develop and maintain device-specific build configurations, including device/, vendor/, and relevant kernel integration components.
Configure product makefiles, product packages, build variants, and system/vendor partition requirements.
Resolve build failures, dependency issues, missing modules, and compilation errors.
Maintain build scripts and documentation for repeatable platform builds.
Bootloader and Platform Bring-Up
Enable the Android boot process on new or existing automotive hardware platforms.
Work with bootloaders such as U-Boot or vendor-specific implementations based on the target SoC.
Configure boot arguments, boot targets, image loading, memory reservations, and device tree handoff.
Coordinate with SoC vendors to resolve platform-specific boot and firmware issues.
Linux Kernel and Device Tree Enablement
Integrate and configure vendor Linux kernels compatible with the selected Android release.
Enable required kernel configurations and device drivers for the target hardware.
Develop, modify, and debug Device Tree Source (DTS/DTSI) files and overlays.
Configure hardware resources such as GPIOs, clocks, regulators, interrupts, IOMMU, DMA, and memory regions.
Integrate vendor kernel modules and troubleshoot module loading or dependency issues.
Hardware Driver and Peripheral Enablement
Enable and validate the hardware peripherals required for an automotive infotainment system, including:
Display interfaces such as MIPI DSI, eDP, LVDS, or HDMI, depending on the platform.
Touchscreen controllers and input devices.
Audio codecs, I²S/TDM interfaces, amplifiers, and audio routing dependencies.
USB host/device controllers, storage, and peripheral connectivity.
Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, GNSS, and Ethernet interfaces.
Camera interfaces and sensor connectivity, where applicable.
I²C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and other SoC peripherals.
Automotive CAN interfaces and related transceivers, where supported by the platform.
Power management ICs, thermal sensors, watchdogs, and suspend/resume functionality.
Hardware Debugging and System Validation
Debug the complete boot flow from bootloader to Android launcher.
Analyze bootloader logs, kernel dmesg, Android Logcat, tombstones, and service startup logs.
Use ADB, fastboot, serial consoles, JTAG, and hardware debugging tools as available.
Automotive Platform Integration
Enable and validate Android Automotive OS on automotive infotainment reference boards and target hardware.
Work with automotive SoC platforms and vendor BSPs from suppliers such as Qualcomm, NXP, or MediaTek, depending on project requirements.
Coordinate with hardware design, BSP, firmware, Android framework, and application teams.
Support hardware variants, board revisions, and product-specific configurations.
Assist with Android compatibility testing and platform validation requirements.

job_description:
Love talking to people? Obsessed with great products? This one's for you.
Company: Offrd (Sequoia AT) – AI-powered HR platform for Indian businesses
Location: Trivandrum / Kochi / Chennai
Experience: Freshers welcome! (0–1 year experience)
Role type: Full-time, customer-facing
Ready to start right away? We’re looking for a sales enthusiast who can jump straight in and drive this role forward with passion and energy.
Why this role is different
Most entry-level jobs bury you in tickets and targets. This one doesn't. You'll be the face and voice of Offrd — an AI-powered HR platform used by hundreds of Indian businesses. Your job is simple: talk to customers, show them what our product can do, help them succeed, and build relationships that last.
The workload is light. The impact is not. You'll get direct exposure to the founder, real customers, and real business decisions from day one — the kind of learning that takes years in a big company.
What you'll actually do
• Be the voice of Offrd — run product demos on Zoom/Meet, welcome new customers, and make them feel at home.
• Chat, call, connect — answer customer questions over calls and chat, and turn confused users into happy fans.
• Show off the good stuff — introduce customers to premium features and help them see the value in upgrading.
• Network like a pro — build genuine relationships with HR and business owners across India.
• Be the customer's champion — pass feedback to the product team and help shape what we build next.
Who we're looking for
• A natural people person — you genuinely enjoy conversations, not just tolerate them.
• Excellent communicator — fluent, confident spoken English (Hindi is a big plus for our North Indian customers).
• Dynamic and self-driven — you don't wait to be told; you spot opportunities and go after them.
• Product-passionate — you love exploring apps, understanding how they work, and explaining them simply.
• Calm under pressure — when a customer reports a problem, you solve it with a smile, not a panic.
• Fresher or up to 1year of experience — in customer success, sales, support, demos, or anything people-facing. Attitude matters more than your resume.
One honest thing you should know
Our customers are business owners and HR teams — and they sometimes need us in the evenings or on weekends. So this role needs someone happy to take a call or reply to a chat outside 9-to-6 hours. In return, the overall workload is genuinely light, and we're flexible with you too. If you see "always reachable, rarely overloaded" as a fair trade, we'll get along great.
What's in it for you
• Fast-track learning: work directly with the founder and core team of a growing SaaS startup.
• Real ownership: your customers, your relationships, your wins.
• A career springboard: this role grows into customer success leadership, product, or growth roles.
• A product people actually use: see your work make a difference for real businesses every single day.

We are looking for a curious, research-oriented individual with a background in Psychology, Behavioural Science or Cognitive Science who can turn research findings into practical solutions.The role focuses on understanding how engineers think, feel and behave toward AI, identifying the barriers to AI adoption, and helping turn AI usage into a consistent daily habit.
A background in any one of these fields is sufficient; a combination of all three is not required. Mindset matters most.
We are looking for someone who does not stop at research or theoretical explanations. You should be able to translate findings into actionable interventions, help implement them, measure their effectiveness and draw clear, evidence-based conclusions.

Assist in designing and conducting behavioural assessments, including scoring and interpreting results using appropriate methods.
Identify the fears, doubts, beliefs and motivations that influence how different engineer personas respond to AI.
Help document behavioural patterns and translate assessment findings into actionable insights.
2. Understanding How People Think – Cognitive Science
Study how engineers learn, interact with and use AI tools in their daily work.
Explore when engineers trust, question, resist or ignore AI-generated outputs.
Identify patterns in learning, decision-making and problem-solving that influence AI adoption.
3. Behaviour Change & Intervention – Behavioural Science
Help design and implement persona-specific interventions to improve AI adoption.
Support experiments and practical initiatives that encourage consistent AI usage.
Track behavioural changes over time using observations, feedback and usage data.
Compare outcomes before and after interventions and recommend improvements based on the findings.
4. Research-to-Action & Reporting
Convert observations into clear hypotheses that can be tested using data.
Support the implementation of research findings
Document results, identify what works and what does not, and communicate clear, decision-ready conclusions.
Refine approaches when evidence shows that an intervention is not effective.
Educational Qualifications
A bachelor's or master's degree in any one of the following fields (Final-semester students from the above disciplines are welcome to apply.)
Psychology (Organisational, Applied, Cognitive, Counselling or any other specialisation)
Behavioural Science or Behavioural Economics
Cognitive Science
Added Advantage
Certification or coursework in behavioural science, behavioural economics, psychometrics or change management.
Research experience through a dissertation, thesis, academic project or publication.

Research-to-Action Mindset
Curious: Looks beyond surface-level answers to understand why people trust, resist or ignore AI.
Hypothesis-driven: Converts observations into testable ideas and validates them using evidence.
Practical: Focuses on solutions that can be implemented in real working environments.
Action-oriented: Moves from findings to implementation without waiting for perfect information.
Evidence-driven: Relies on observed behaviour, feedback and usage data rather than opinions alone.
Outcome-focused: Measures results, draws clear conclusions and recommends the next steps.
Adaptable: Accepts when an approach does not work and changes direction based on evidence.
Essential Skills
Strong interest in human behaviour and willingness to learn behavioural assessment tools.
Basic Excel skills and comfort working with data.
Clear written and verbal communication in English.
Ability to explain research findings in simple, practical terms.

job_title: Senior Full Stack: AI-Assisted Development & Deployment (3 to 6 Yrs)
job_description:
Experience : 3 - 6 Years Salary Package : 10 - 20 LPAWork From Office Trivandrum
We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to build and deploy applications end to end, using AI coding tools as a core part of the daily workflow rather than an occasional aid. The role covers hands-on development, deployment automation, and defining the specifications and standards that keep AI-assisted work consistent and reliable across projects. The ideal candidate is someone who already builds software faster and better by working closely with AI tools, and who can help set the standards and templates other engineers on the team follow.
Key Responsibilities
Design the Practice
Define specification formats, API contract standards, and project templates used as the starting point for new builds.
Establish coding standards, engineering-context files, and AI-usage guidelines that keep AI-assisted output consistent and safe across projects.
Determine where AI tools are used in the workflow (implementation, testing, documentation, review) and where manual review is required.
Build the Reference Implementation
Design and build full-stack applications end to end, applying established specifications, standards, and pipeline as the reference implementation.
Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and release strategy as a reusable capability across projects, not a one-off setup per project.
Deploy applications to cloud and containerised environments and monitor performance after release.
Roll Out & Support Adoption
Onboard other engineers and teams onto established workflows, including walkthroughs and support during initial adoption.
Review code from teams following the practice, including AI-generated code, applying consistent quality standards.
Incorporate delivery outcomes and feedback from adopting teams to refine templates, guidelines, and pipelines on an ongoing basis.
preferred_skills:
Full-Stack Development
3–6 years of hands-on experience building and shipping full-stack applications in production.
Strong hands-on experience with React.js or Angular on the frontend, and Node.js and/or Python on the backend.
Experience owning CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation, including working knowledge of Docker and at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Solid Git workflow discipline and experience working from written specifications rather than verbal requirements.
Working knowledge of relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and familiarity with NoSQL databases.
Understanding of authentication mechanisms such as JWT and OAuth.
AI Tools & Usage
Hands-on, daily experience using AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar tools for writing, reviewing, and debugging code.
Working knowledge of more than one AI tool or model, and the judgment to choose the right one for a given task rather than defaulting to a single tool.
Practical experience using AI tools beyond code generation - for testing, documentation, code review, and troubleshooting.
Ability to write clear, effective prompts and instructions to get accurate, usable output from AI tools, and to catch and correct AI mistakes.
A genuine, active interest in keeping up with new AI tools, models, and techniques as they evolve.
Communication
Strong written and spoken communication skills in English
Strong interpretation skills: the ability to read a specification, ticket, or instruction carefully and understand exactly what is being asked, asking clarifying questions when something is unclear.
Ability to clearly explain technical decisions and AI-assisted work to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Preferred Skills
Experience designing or documenting an engineering workflow, standard, or template adopted by other engineers or teams.
Experience with TypeScript across frontend and backend.
Exposure to Kubernetes or other container orchestration beyond basic Docker usage.
Experience with GraphQL, WebSockets, serverless, or event-driven architectures.
Familiarity with observability tooling such as Sentry, Prometheus, or Grafana.
Experience mentoring developers within Agile teams.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience.

job_title: Senior Software Engineer – AI-Augmented Software Development-REMOTE:6+ Yrs
job_description:
Job Description
Experience Required: 6+ years (Remote)Employment Type: Full-timePackage offered- 20- 30 LPA
About the Role
We're looking for a hands-on Senior engineer who primarily focuses on building high-quality software, with strong capabilities in evaluating code quality and owning end-to-end delivery across the SDLC . This person will work extensively with AI-assisted development tools and will be accountable for ensuring every deliverable — whether built internally, by vendors, or with AI assistance — meets high standards of correctness, quality, security, and compliance. You'll be the connective tissue between development, QA, the AI SDLC framework, vendors, and clients — driving execution while holding the line on engineering excellence.
Key Responsibilities
Development- Primary Responsibility
● Write, review, and refactor production-grade code across the stack as needed
● Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery without compromising quality or introducing technical debt
● Set and model engineering best practices: clean architecture, maintainability, performance, and scalability
Quality & Security
● Review deliverables with a QA mindset — functional correctness, edge case coverage, regression risk, and test adequacy
● Conduct security-focused code reviews (secure coding practices, common vulnerability classes, dependency risk, data handling)
● Define and enforce quality gates and Definition-of-Done criteria across the SDLC
● Ensure compliance with relevant coding, security, and regulatory standards
Delivery & Orchestration
● Own the complete SDLC lifecycle — planning, development, testing, deployment, and release
● Coordinate across development teams, QA, and the AI SDLC framework/tooling to keep delivery on track
● Act as the primary technical point of contact for vendors and clients, translating requirements and validating vendor deliverables against internal quality bars
● Identify bottlenecks or risks across teams/departments and drive them to resolution proactively
● Report on delivery health, quality metrics, and risk status to stakeholders
Required Skills
● Programming Languages: Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Python, C#, Go, or similar); ability to read and reason about code in adjacent languages is a plus
● Software Design & Architecture: Solid grasp of design patterns, clean code principles, and system/API design
● Testing & QA Practices: Familiarity with unit, integration, and end-to-end testing frameworks; ability to assess test coverage and quality, not just write tests
● Test Automation Frameworks: Hands-on experience with at least one automated testing framework such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar — able to write, review, and evaluate automated test suites as part of the quality gate
● Security Fundamentals: Working knowledge of secure coding practices and common vulnerability classes (e.g., OWASP Top 10), plus basics of dependency and data-handling risk
● AI-Assisted Development Tools: Hands-on experience with tools like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar
● Version Control & CI/CD: Practical experience with Git-based workflows and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar)
● Cloud & Infrastructure Basics: Working familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization basics (Docker)
● Code Review & Static Analysis: Comfort using or setting up static analysis, linting, and code quality tools (e.g., SonarQube, ESLint, or similar)
● Communication & Stakeholder Coordination: Ability to clearly communicate technical decisions and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders (dev, QA, vendors, clients)
Required Qualifications
● 6+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on coding ability in at least one modern stack
● Demonstrated experience reviewing others' code for quality, logic correctness, and security — not just writing code
● Solid understanding of secure coding practices and common vulnerability patterns (e.g., OWASP Top 10 or equivalent)
● Experience working with or evaluating AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar)
● Proven experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders — development, QA, vendors, and clients
● Strong understanding of SDLC methodologies (Agile/Scrum, CI/CD pipelines, release management)
● Excellent communication skills to bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders
preferred_skills:
● Prior experience in a technical ownership, architect, or cross-team coordination capacity
● Experience working within an AI-augmented SDLC framework (AI-assisted pipelines with human review checkpoints)
● Vendor management or client-facing delivery experience
What Success Looks Like
● Deliverables consistently meet quality, security, and compliance bars before release
● Cross-team handoffs (dev → QA → vendor → client) happen with minimal friction or rework
● AI tooling is used effectively to boost velocity without introducing quality or security regressions
● Stakeholders (internal and client-side) trust this person as the final technical checkpoint before sign-off
